name: Buffalo Chicken Mozzarella Sticks
desc: A frozen block of buffalo chicken, cream cheese and mozzarella cut into sticks, double breaded and deep fried.

source.title: Buffalo Chicken Mozzarella Sticks
source.evidence: Saved Instagram reel; caption and on-screen text captured in the owner's saved-recipes export

steps: Line a 9x5 inch loaf pan with parchment, leaving some overhang on the long sides.
In a large bowl, mix the chicken, cream cheese, mozzarella, buffalo sauce, pepper, garlic powder and onion powder until even. Press it firmly and evenly into the pan.
Freeze until firm enough to slice cleanly, 1 to 2 hours.
Lift the block out by the parchment and cut it into 8 sticks.
Set up the eggs and breadcrumbs in two shallow dishes. Dip each stick in egg, then breadcrumbs, then egg and breadcrumbs again for a double coat.
Heat about 2 inches of oil in a heavy pot to 375°F. Fry the sticks in two batches, turning occasionally, until deep golden brown all over, 1 to 2 min. Drain on a rack or paper towels and serve warm.
tips: Freezing the block makes them easy to cut and bread.
Tasty's version fries smaller sticks for about 30 seconds at 375°F; these are thicker, so watch for color, and pull them before the cheese starts leaking.
If the breaded sticks soften while you work, put them back in the freezer for 15 min before frying.
